# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cartography)
library(khroma)
library(treeio)

# Import tree
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
RAxML_core_tree <- read.tree("raxml.tre")
RAxML_core_tree_mid <- midpoint.root(RAxML_core_tree)
Fasttree_full_tree <- read.tree("Fastree_SP.tre")
Fasttree_full_tree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree_full_tree)
Fasttree_full_tree_DP <- read.tree("Fastree_DP.tre")
Fasttree_full_tree_DP_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree_full_tree_DP)
IQtree_core_tree <- read.tree("IQtree.tre")
IQtree_core_tree_mid <- midpoint.root(IQtree_core_tree)

# Load metadata
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
serotypes <- read.table("Serotypes.txt", header=T)
CCs <- read.csv("combined_results_with_cc.txt")
SCs <- read.csv("GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs), SCs)

# Prep metadata for tree
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=5)
metadata_tree_v0 <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:12, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI", "VIII")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% RAxML_core_tree_mid$tip.label)

# Join metadata and tree 
RAxML_core_tree_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(RAxML_core_tree_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')
Fasttree_full_tree_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Fasttree_full_tree_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')
Fasttree_full_tree_DP_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Fasttree_full_tree_DP_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')
IQtree_core_tree_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(IQtree_core_tree_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## Serotype
Metadata_Serotype = metadata_tree_v0 |> select(Serotype2)
row.names(Metadata_Serotype) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Serotype)= c("1")
## CC
Metadata_CC= metadata_tree_v0 |> select(clonal_complex)
row.names(Metadata_CC) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_CC)= c("2")

# Prepare colors for phylo
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd","#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#f7b6d2",  "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")
Serotype_colors <- c(color("muted")(9),"#D55E00" , "grey")
names(Serotype_colors) <- levels(Metadata_Serotype[,1])
CC_colors <- carto.pal(pal1 = "pastel.pal" ,n1 = 12)
```


# Plot RAxML core aln tree
```{r}
# SC tips
p1 <- ggtree(RAxML_core_tree_mid_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)

# Serotype
p2 <- gheatmap(p1 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Serotype ,  width=0.15, offset=0.0001, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Serotype_colors, name="1: Serotype")

# CCs
p3 <- gheatmap(p2 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_CC,  width=0.15, offset=0.0002,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = CC_colors, name="2: CC")

p3

ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/RAxML_core.png", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")

```
